changes.title: fix(qwen): propagate MTP positional overrides
changes.note: The draft model resolved 262,144 positions from its checkpoint while the target resolved 1,048,576, so a full-length prefill was rejected.

changes.title: perf(qwen): shard TP4 HC prefill and coalesce recurrent checkpoints
changes.note: Opt-in: the tail coalescing and token-ownership paths are off unless the deployment enables them.

changes.title: Adaptive spin grace and bounded architectural waits for shm_broadcast
changes.note: The pinned revision carries the bounded-wait half. The patch adds the adaptive grace half, reproducing randomvariable/vllm refs/heads/dev/rv-jovian-judgement at 3c948029c899219ce5d7c4bbb565e20d7bc6a837. Keep it for every tensor-parallel model: without it the mp executor busy-spins.

changes.title: Rewrite flash_attn.cute imports to vllm.vllm_flash_attn.cute
changes.note: Packaging repair for this builder's symlink install path, which skips the import rewrite the upstream CMake copy performs. It carries no upstream change.

changes.title: fix(preparation): retain prepared launchers and coordinate collectives
changes.note: Includes the RoCE one-shot dtype fix, the collective entry barrier, and the source-hashed JIT extension build directory.
